title: relay-run step must refuse a new task on an existing step
lead: `relay-run step RUN --step N` with a `--task` that differs from the step's recorded task exits 2 and tells the caller to record a new step, so a heartbeat or a later round can no longer erase what the step was.
findings_note: nested-relay trial idea0, 2026-10-15, defect 5: heartbeat overwrote S16 step 2 task
boundary:
**Not in this slice:**
- Other fields on an update (phase, model, reasoning) keep today's rule.
- `fold` keeps reading ledgers that already hold an overwrite.
- The ledger location (its own item).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The idea0 nested-relay trial on 2026-10-15 (defect 5): the S16 orchestrator re-recorded step 2 with `--phase start --task "S16 fix round 1"` for a fix round. `fold` in `src/slicer/relayrun.py` applies every non-empty field of an update ("an update names only what changes"), so the step's task now read "S16 fix round 1" and "S16 implement" was gone from `relay-run list` and the board. S03, which recorded a new step per round, kept both. The owner chose on 2026-10-15 to refuse the overwrite. Recording stays advisory: the relay text already says a failed `relay-run` call never stops the relay.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/ops.py`, `relay_run_step`: on an update, a non-empty `task` that differs from the step's task is `bad_run_field` (exit 2), with a message saying to record a new step without `--step`, and nothing is appended. The same task again is allowed, and so is no task.
- `src/slicer/ai.py`, `## Order`: the heartbeat sentence says a heartbeat passes no `--task`, and each round records its own step.
- `docs/commands.md`, the `relay-run step` row; `docs/agents.md`, `bad_run_field`; `CHANGELOG.md`.
- `tests/test_relay_run.py`, and the `test_AiRelay_*` tests in `tests/test_relay_roles.py`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `test_RelayRunStep_Update_NewTask_Refused`: `--step 1 --phase start --task other` exits 2 with `bad_run_field`, and the ledger has no new line.
- `test_RelayRunStep_Update_SameTask_Allowed`: the same task again appends a heartbeat.
- `test_RelayRunStep_Heartbeat_NoTask_KeepsTask`: `--step 1 --phase start` with no task keeps the step's task.
- `test_AiRelay_Order_HeartbeatPassesNoTask`: `## Order` says a heartbeat passes no `--task`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests and watch them go red, one mutation each.
2. Add the check in `relay_run_step`, then the relay text sentence.
3. Update the docs and the CHANGELOG.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/s299`, branch `feature/s299-step-task`. Commit only on the branch. Merging and pushing wait for the owner.
